text:
Harper: Heads-up 1  prepping the newsletter invite for the benchmark + ops webinar. Target send Thu 8:30AM PT for NA/EU and a staggered APAC at Thu 8:30AM SGT. Need final subject, RSVP gating, and who gets the "ghost" nurture after webinar.
Dina: Primary cohorts: trial-30d, engaged-newsletter (opened 30d), docs-downloaders. Pull docs-downloaders into the high-intent bucket and exclude them from subject tests.
Omar: RSVP form should capture role, team size, intent (benchmark/cost/ops) and a boolean "want demo". Hidden UTMs: utm_campaign=bench_apr, utm_medium=email, cohort={cohort}.
Cleo: Subject candidates: 1) "Join: our inference benchmark + live ops demo" 2) "Benchmark results: latency, cost, and what to change" 3) "How teams shave inference cost in prod" 1 will test A/B across engaged-newsletter.
Harper: Suppress: anyone who attended or RSVP'd in past 60d, unsubscribed, or bounced. Also de-dupe across cohorts (highest intent wins).
Dina: Routing rules idea: if (role matches /(Head|Director|CTO|ML|PM)/ or company_size >= 500) -> sdr-enterprise; else if (cohort == "trial") -> sdr-trial; else -> sdr-nurture. Quick pseudo-rule:
```
if (role =~ /(Head|Director|CTO|ML|PM)/ || company_size >= 500) {
  owner = "sdr-enterprise"
} else if (cohort == "trial") {
  owner = "sdr-trial"
} else {
  owner = "sdr-nurture"
}
```
Omar: For docs-downloaders tagged as "high-intent", include a post-RSVP modal with "book a demo" link and pass lead_score=high.
Cleo: Ghost nurture flow after webinar: attendees -> product content track; no-shows who RSVP'd -> follow-up with on-demand recording + CTA to book; non-RSVP high-intent -> direct SDR outreach within 48h.
Harper: Timing & send splits: 10% subject A/B for engaged-newsletter; trials get subject C only. APAC send separate with localized time mention in body.
Dina: Preheader options: "Thu 8:30AM PT  20min demo + Q&A" or "See latency & cost breakdowns live". Keep it short.
send-bot: Deploy note: webhook for RSVP -> CRM staging scheduled Wed 19:00 PT. Please QA mapping of utm, cohort, and role fields.
Omar: I'll drop segments CSV to /marketing/seg-exports/bench-apr by EOD and mark APAC timezone users.
Cleo: Final copy drop ETA 2hrs in #copy-review. I'll include variants for APAC localization and the RSVP confirmation modal copy.
Harper: Owners: Omar (segments + exports), Dina (RSVP form + suppression), Cleo (copy + post-webinar nurture), send-bot (webhook deploy). We do a 15m pre-send check Wed 3PM PT. Ping here when fields are wired. :white_check_mark:
